items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was playing a gig with them, I guess a couple years ago.

ctx.x: Well, even then…Let’s see was it Ver Plank? Yes, she was married to Billy Ver Plank, a pianist and arranger. I was playing a gig with them, I guess a couple years ago.
That is a lot of dates
